subject: inactivity, light, moderous and vigurous intensity times in day-segemented analysis

messages.author: 817de18ddde0ac9e
messages.subject: inactivity, light, moderous and vigurous intensity times in day-segemented analysis
parts:
Hi all,

 

I have a general question: Is it possible to get the inactivity time, light, moderous and vigurous PA time of the segments of a day? So for example the inactivity time during work? Because when I work with the qwindow line, the output part 2 gives me the MVPA, LX and MX values and so on but in output 5 there is still only the inactivity time over all. Or can someone explain me, how exactly the inactivity, light, moderous and vigurous times are computed (in output part 5) so that I can compute them by myself?

 

 

Kind regards,

Elena

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] inactivity, light, moderous and vigurous intensity times in day-segemented analysis
parts:
Hi Elena,

GGIR part 2 provides time spent per intensity level per segment of the day (argument ilevels and qwindow), but does not consider the concept of bouted and unbouted behaviour. Bouted and unbouted behaviour is currently only extracted in part 5 for the waking hours as a whole.

So, I think your question is whether bouts in inactivity, LIPA, etc can be derived with GGIR?
Answer: This is not possible at the moment. Technically it would be possible but that would require a significant time investment, which is hard for me or Jairo to do on a voluntary basis.

Possible solutions:
  • You find someone to develop this and make a GitHub pull request.
  • You hire us to develop this. In that case I would be happy to discuss details and provide a quote via email or a call.

Kind regards,

Vincent
